text: Compiler::fgInlineAppendAsyncFrameStatements in src/coreclr/jit/fginline.cpp emits it; the helper is AsyncHelpers.RestoreInlinedFrameContexts in src/coreclr/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Runtime/CompilerServices/AsyncHelpers.CoreCLR.cs.
